category_title: Students with ASD exhibiting out-of-seat and assaultive behavior for attention
scenario_title: Difficult academic tasks during morning lessons
minimal_context: Brian is expected to complete his morning academic programmes at his table in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Brian, it is time to start our morning lessons. We have five academic programmes to work through at your table today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from his chair and steps away from the table) I don't want to do these.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down and try to do the work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks away from the table and heads toward the classroom door, looking back to see if you are watching)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Brian, you need to come back to your table right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains away from the table and shoves a peer who is sitting nearby)
